legend: Villous adenoma is characterized by elongated villous structures lined by epithelium with focal intestinal metaplasia, nuclear pleomorphism, and hyperchromasia. Tubular areas are also present focally.

diagnosis: Villous adenoma of the urinary bladder
legend: Elongated villous architecture lined by epithelium with focal intestinal metaplasia, nuclear pleomorphism, crowding, and hyperchromasia.
